Why Choose Us

Why TransMedex Is the Right Partner for Florida Practices

Every state has its own payer landscape, regulatory environment, and billing quirks. TransMedex has deep, in-state expertise to make sure your practice stays compliant and gets paid faster.

Florida-Specific Compliance

We stay up-to-date on every Florida Medicaid, payer, and regulatory change so your claims are always compliant — reducing rejections before they happen.

AI-Powered Revenue Cycle

Our AI scrubs every claim before submission, catching errors in real-time and achieving a 98.99% clean claim rate that accelerates your cash flow.

48-Hour Turnaround

From charge capture to claim submission in under 48 hours. Faster billing means faster payments and a healthier accounts receivable balance.

Dedicated Billing Team

You get a named, dedicated account manager and billing team who knows your practice, your payer mix in Florida, and your specialty inside-out.

Denial Management & Appeals

We don't just refile — we analyze denial patterns, fix root causes, and file targeted appeals to recover every dollar you're owed.

AAPC-Certified Coders

All coding is handled by AAPC-certified specialists. Accurate ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding that maximizes reimbursement across all specialties.

What Medical Billing Challenges do Florida Practices Commonly Face?

Medical practices in Florida face multiple billing challenges — from operational complexity to payer-specific rules — that can significantly impact revenue cycle efficiency.

High Medicare Population

Managing the complexities of Medicare billing, including MACRA, MIPS, and frequent policy updates.

Strict PIP Laws

Navigating Florida's Personal Injury Protection (PIP) laws for accident-related claims.

Seasonal Population Shifts

Handling fluctuating patient volumes and out-of-state insurance plans during winter months.

Managed Care Complexity

Dealing with numerous managed care organizations and their specific credentialing requirements.

How TransMedex Helps Practices With Their Medical Billing Services in Florida?

TransMedex provides comprehensive medical billing services to help Florida practices overcome complex billing and compliance challenges.

Prior Authorization Management

Secures necessary approvals from insurers for procedures and treatments before service delivery.

Accurate Medical Coding

Assigns correct ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes to diagnoses and procedures for proper reimbursement.

Charge Entry & Validation

Records and verifies all charges to ensure accuracy and completeness before claim submission.
